fit_info.manual_overrides_note: Several params overridden post-fit because the training bag was 74% stops (v < 0.5 m/s), which dragged the regression away from the kart's actual high-speed driving behavior. Reverted to bicycle defaults / pathfinder.yaml values:  steer_gain=1.0 (was 0.245), steer_rate_max_degps=180 (was 30), accel_tau=0.6 (was 4.9), brake_tau=0.4 (was 5.0). Re-identify these with stops filtered out for a cleaner fit; for now this gives a sim that tracks the line at 6 m/s to match the real kart's normal operation.
